verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a dedicated re-authorise account consent endpoint for prompting the account holder for continued access when a previously AUTHORIZED consent can no longer retrieve data, which is the repair flow that avoids starting a fresh connection. However, the evidence names only the AUTHORIZED status and never documents the expired or revoked statuses, and webhooks are not shown to notify on consent breakage. Missing for 10: documented expired/revoked consent status values, webhook or event notification for consent expiry or revocation, detail on whether re-authorisation preserves the existing consent and account linkage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
